_about: Minimal evidence schema for the future isolated run. Checked by check-package.mjs (hand-rolled, no dependency). Rules: policy LOADED is never PASS for enforcement; evidence_kind MOCK_ENDPOINT or DIRECT_FEED is never presented as real-model evidence; PASS needs evidence_sha256 of an artifact. Human-readable acceptance matrix: see ../ACCEPTANCE-CRITERIA.md (K2-05-C hazırlık belgesi, O1-O7). Structural lock: observation O6 can never carry status PASS or be used as an acceptance criterion for any gate (see check-package.mjs checkO6Lock); it is DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY/NOT_TESTED until the owner defines the symptom.
export: Option A: separate writable C:\export mapping, per-run manifest and completion marker; see EXPORT-DESIGN.md.
